blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Some 255 students in Alangalang and MacArthur towns in Leyte have received free prescription eyeglasses after a vision screening found them struggling with eyesight problems that could affect their classroom performance. The 255 beneficiaries got their eyeglasses on Tuesday, Nov. 17, through a school-based vision care program of the Mabuhay Deseret Foundation (MDF). This event follows the eye examinations conducted on Oct. 19 and 21 that covered more than 500 learners. Janis Redulla, MDF’s Visayas screener, said the beneficiaries were identified through visual acuity tests designed to detect nearsightedness, farsightedness and other common vision problems.
